info.name: Reference ETL Server
info.description:
Comprehensive newman/Postman suite for Reference.Etl.Server (18 endpoints).

Auth: OpenIddict password-grant (POST /connect/token, form-encoded).
Access token stored in {{accessToken}}, sent as Authorization: Bearer.
Preview slot base URL: {{baseUrl}} = https://etl-mt.preview.cyberdynedevelopment.dev/api/v1

Run:
  newman run Reference-Etl.postman_collection.json -e Reference-Etl.postman_environment.json
